purpose: Two connected Git LFS storage pools with one physical PDF copy per book. The pools are complementary, not mirrored.

storage_contract.distribution: Each verified PDF is assigned deterministically to exactly one pool from its SHA-256; it is never copied to the other pool.
storage_contract.source_failover: immediate next independent catalogued source on restriction/failure
storage_contract.no_source_quota: the engine does not stop after a provider-specific book count

activation.write_scope: repository contents read/write for the secondary storage repository

failure_policy: If a verified PDF cannot be persisted to its assigned pool, the acquisition cycle fails closed. A second PDF copy is never created as a fallback; the book is retried from its sources instead.
